senses.gloss: a long journey, especially by sea or through space

translations.th_TH: การเดินทาง; การเดินทาง

definition_translations.zh_TW: 長途旅行，尤指海上或太空旅行
definition_translations.ja_JP: 長い旅、特に海上や宇宙での旅

definition_translations.vi_VN: hành trình dài, đặc biệt bằng đường biển hoặc trong không gian

senses.gloss: to travel on a long journey, especially by sea
senses.example: The crew voyaged across the Atlantic in difficult weather.
